name: Chaos Crew

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds land with multipliers that are added together on a winning line.

features.name: Sticky wild free spins
features.description: The top bonus keeps wilds in place and increases their multiplier each time a new wild lands.

review: Chaos Crew is an early Hacksaw release that set the studio's template: a compact 5x5 grid, multiplier wilds and a sticky bonus that can snowball. Its punk-style art is still distinctive. It's less varied than Wanted Dead or a Wild but easier to understand, which makes it a good introduction to Hacksaw's style.
cons: Bonus often ends without building up
